sources.title: David Tong, TASI Lectures on Solitons: Instantons, Monopoles, Vortices and Kinks
sources.locator: Full 139-page PDF retrieved and inspected. §2.1 The Basics (model setup); §2.1.1 equations (2.9)–(2.15), printed pp. 41–42; §2.1.2 equations (2.16)–(2.18), printed pp. 42–43; §2.1.3 equation (2.19), printed p. 43. PDF pages are printed page plus two.

contents.name: §2.1 The Basics: SU(N) adjoint-Higgs model, vacuum breaking, and boundary topology
contents.scope: The carrier fixes its own SU(2), right-action, metric, invariant-form, and rescaled energy conventions rather than importing the source normalization.

contents.name: §2.1.1 Dirac Quantization Condition and patch transition
contents.scope: The source supports the single-valued transition and magnetic charge lattice; the local theorem gives the full patch/Stokes derivation for the selected SU(2) and doublet-probe data.

contents.name: §2.1.2 The Monopole Equations and square completion
contents.scope: The source confirms the Bianchi surface term, square completion, sign dependence, and first-order equation; the item proves both identities in its declared normalization.

contents.name: §2.1.3 The charge-one Prasad–Sommerfield SU(2) profile
contents.scope: The source supplies the standard radial functions and hedgehog shape; the item derives regularity, the equation, flux, and energy in its sign convention.

sources.title: Jeffrey A. Harvey, Magnetic Monopoles, Duality, and Supersymmetry
sources.locator: Full 62-page PDF inspected. §1.4 equations (1.20)–(1.40); §2.1 equations (2.1)–(2.6); §2.2 equations (2.7)–(2.9).

contents.name: §1.4 The 't Hooft–Polyakov SU(2) Yang–Mills–Higgs model and asymptotic winding
contents.scope: Supports the chosen adjoint scalar, zero-potential limit, SU(2) to U(1) reduction, and finite-energy boundary map; the carrier fixes a separate classical model from the assigned pure-Yang–Mills postulate.

contents.name: §1.4 Magnetic charge, fundamental-doublet quantization, and transition topology
contents.scope: The source identifies the fundamental doublet electric weight and 4π/e charge unit; its cited homotopy-sequence result is not imported, since the local proof derives the selected transition formula directly.

contents.name: §2.1 Symmetric monopoles and the Bogomolny bound
contents.scope: Supports the Bianchi integration-by-parts route, zero-potential qualification, bound, and first-order equations; the local proof supplies both signs and the zero-charge equality case.

contents.name: §2.2 The Prasad–Sommerfield solution
contents.scope: Supports the radial ODE solution and asymptotic profile; the example independently checks the fields in the repository's conventions.
